reply_text:
*One ship-blocking finding* in `billing-anniversary` (`f73b00d`) against `main`.

*CRITICAL — `src/schedule.js:6–7`: clamps against the source month, not the target month.*
This produces incorrect renewal dates in both directions:
• Jan 31, 2026, anchor 31 → *Mar 3*, instead of Feb 28 (skips February).
• Feb 28, 2026, anchor 31 → *Mar 28*, instead of Mar 31 (loses the anniversary).
• Jan 31, 2028, anchor 31 → *Mar 2*, instead of Feb 29.

*Recommended fix:* use `daysInMonth(year, month + 1)` when calculating `day`. Add regression tests for January→February in leap/non-leap years and February→March retaining anchor 31. The existing tests in `test/schedule.test.js` cover only March→April and December→January, which miss this.

*Validation:* all 5 existing tests pass; a separate 2026–2028 calendar sweep found 40 incorrect results across 1,116 month/anchor combinations.

No additional findings. No files changed.
